reviewedProposedFix.assessment: No concrete production defect found in reviewed helper. It is applied only after sealed trace validation; malformed/unreadable final trace still throws and remains in-flight/unknown. Recorded assessment and usage remain intact, and cleanup agent/error or aborted turn/end does not overwrite causal limit.

reviewedProposedFix.initialRegressionCaveat: Waiting for modelError inside a successful status response makes the race likely and can establish it via red run, but the hook alone does not prove the preceding trace lacked stream_limit if the first successful response already contains modelError. For fully deterministic construction, gate oversized provider emission until a status fetch has entered after the trace read, or assert the captured stale trace boundary.
